title: Wilmette Historical Museum

services.name: Adult Tours
services.desc: School programs are scheduled Mondays through Thursdays. A minimum of three weeks’ notice is necessary. This program is designed to introduce young children (ages 4-6) to local history. Children learn about Wilmette’s namesake first family, the Ouilmettes. The program includes a read-aloud story, a short museum tour, and a coloring project. An introductory slideshow about Wilmette history begins the program looking at similarities and differences between the past and present. Next, students tour the museum with one of our expert guides.
